'''Tunisian Sign Language''' ({{Langx|ar|لغة الإشارة التونسية|translit=Lughat al-Ishārah al-Tūnisīyah}}; {{Langx|fr|Langue des signes tunisienne}}) is the [[sign language]] used by deaf people in [[Tunisia]]. It derives from [[Italian Sign Language]], mixed with [[indigenous sign]].

It is not clear how the language of the [[Burj as-Salh]] deaf village relates to indigenous sign and TSL.<ref>{{cite web |date=6 November 2016 |title=8 Deaf Villages Around the World and How They Came to be |url=https://deafniche.com/8deaf-villages-around-world/ |website=deafniche.com}}</ref>
